description: Use this when the user wants to look through everything 2hives has for a topic or language, rather than get one session. Not for medical questions, emergencies or a crisis. Not for general chat about meditation.

kind.description: Limit to one kind: sleep, calm, breath (breathing), focus, body (body scan), nature (nature sounds with a voice). Default all.

language.description: Audio language as a BCP-47 code (en, es, pt-BR, fr, it, ja, hi, ko, hu, or any other such as pl). Always pass the language the user writes in. If the language is not available the answer says so and gives the closest live one. hi, ko and hu are beta.
